description: My Business Matches (MBM) is the definitive source for federal agencies when it comes to their Event & Business Matchmaking needs. Our platform deals with event preparation, conference management and vendor outreach for any onsite, hybrid or virtual occasion, in need of support. You can access our technology effortlessly as it is created to be compliant with federal devices and firewalls. MBM is a FedRAMP Authorized Secure Service! Be assured that our gathering functions let you provide both safe and interactive webinars, business matchmaking, networking roundtables and speakers engagements.
